root_cause: QuestionDetail.Tags field serialised as json:"tags" but frontend QuestionDetail interface expected key tag_ids. detailToForm always read q.tag_ids which was undefined, resetting tags to [] on every refetch after save.
fix_description: Renamed Tags field in QuestionDetail to TagIDs with json tag \"tag_ids\" so the backend response key matches what the frontend expects. Updated all struct literals that assigned to the old Tags field. No frontend changes needed — it already reads q.tag_ids correctly.
